provider: ElevenLabs Image & Video API, model creatify-aurora 720p
approval: Review revision: fixed per-source color and uniform registration. Previous mask approval does not imply approval of these display copies.

spliceMeasurement.method: greeting frame 0/115 against the base eye-contact idle frame 0 and the dealer take frame 0; phase correlation of head/torso/hand windows, dx/dy in source px
spliceMeasurement.note: Source registration and actorOffset remain bound to the original take. The display copy adds the fixed uniform transform and RGB gain recorded in media.displayCalibration; entry/exit maps are measured from those calibrated pixels.

greeting.text: Welcome to Privé Blackjack. Take a seat, I'll be your dealer tonight.

audioMeasurement.method: cross-correlation of the take's embedded AAC track against the line mp3 (44.1 kHz mono)

registration.method: phase correlation of gradient images (actor masked out) against frame 0 of assets/astrid-3d/greenscreen/take-dealer-first-card.mp4 (1920x1080, the runtime placement basis); windows leftRail/rightRail/shoe agree at dx 0/-1, dy 15 for scale 1.5; frontRail dy 9 (generative drift, not corrected)
registration.resample: scale=1920:1056 lanczos, pad=1920:1080 at (0,15) with backdrop green 0x196f2d, fps=24 by frame drop (timing kept for lip sync), audio copied

greeting.readyPose: frame 0 and the last frame (both the plate ready pose; hands, shoe and card stationary)

transition.method: Fixed uniform registration and RGB calibration, then bidirectional DIS whole-actor silent join. Native speech frames and exact mp3 timing retained. New visual review required.
